data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek words ‘gardos’ (spear) and ‘alos’ (protector). In ancient Greece, Gardal represented a warrior or protector armed with a spear. The name Gardal carries the meaning “Protector of the Spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gardal usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gardal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

It's a name that can inspire courage, resilience, and determination, allowing the bearer to be a beacon of strength and support to those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Gardal also holds deep spiritual meaning, symbolizing a divine protector who shields the bearer from harm and guides them through life's battles. In the Bible, we see this concept embodied in the character of God as our protector and shield, who is with us in times of trouble and adversity (Psalm 18:2). The name Gardal serves as a reminder of this spiritual truth, encouraging the bearer to rely on God's strength and guidance in all aspects of their life.
